source.behavior: Open the current user's site-specific email settings surface, load only sites visible in the active account/tenant scope, and render the selected site's persisted email-recipient state. SMTP passwords remain protected and are never displayed after saving.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The explicit site-specific GET route executes SiteEmailSettingsController::site, authorizes the active tenant member, resolves the site through tenant-scoped models, rereads persisted recipients, and renders the real site email settings view. The sibling module route and recipient-add mutation remain separate canonical operations.

authorization.guest_semantics: redirect to canonical login before tenant-owned data is rendered
authorization.direct_id_semantics: the caller-supplied numeric site ID is resolved under active TenantContext; foreign-tenant IDs return 404

tenant_isolation.server_derived_ownership: TenantContext is established from the authenticated active membership; controller verifies the route tenant slug and all Site/SiteEmailRecipient queries remain tenant-scoped.
tenant_isolation.idor_proof: Focused acceptance creates Alpha and Beta sites and proves Alpha cannot render Beta either by substituting the site ID under Alpha or by directly selecting the Beta tenant route.

read_and_failure_semantics.authoritative_reread: GET resolves the selected Site and reads persisted recipients on each request.
read_and_failure_semantics.truthful_success: 200 is asserted only after the real guarded controller successfully resolves the active tenant site and renders persisted state.
read_and_failure_semantics.retry: safe; GET is read-only and repeatable
read_and_failure_semantics.cancellation: not applicable to synchronous read route

csrf_and_mutation_boundary.selected_operation: GET only; no CSRF-bearing server mutation is introduced.
csrf_and_mutation_boundary.existing_recipient_mutation: POST /tenants/{tenant}/sites/{site}/email-settings/recipients remains a separate canonical operation AIMW-BILL-07134347F9 under web/auth/tenant.context and its Blade form retains @csrf.

secret_provider_wordpress_boundaries.smtp_secret_non_exposure: The route/controller do not return password ciphertext or SMTP/provider secret fields; focused response acceptance checks common secret markers are absent.
secret_provider_wordpress_boundaries.provider_calls: No email-provider send/test call is performed by this route operation.
secret_provider_wordpress_boundaries.wordpress_connector: No WordPress or Connector call is performed by this route operation.
secret_provider_wordpress_boundaries.ai_provider: No AI-provider call or secret is touched.
secret_provider_wordpress_boundaries.queue_cache_scheduler: No queue, cache, scheduler, or background job side effect is introduced.

terminality.basis: A real guarded Laravel site-specific email-settings route is explicitly operation-bound and proven to preserve authenticated tenant/site isolation, permission checks, authoritative persisted reads, read-only semantics, separate CSRF-protected mutations, and secret/provider boundaries.
